purpose: Documentation index keyed by valid current spectral query configurations; not a run result, evidence importer, or minimum lookup used by the engine.
scope: One-pronged discs n=3..7, closed orientable genus 2 and 3, unrestricted D10/D12/D14/D18/D22/D26; nonorientable N22 excluded.
configuration_notes: Each current_query_configuration is a new lower-bound question in ttauto-proof-v1, even if the historical route used folding.
All queries use portable Python newton; budgets are starter limits, not historical stopping rules or completeness claims.
Historical automata, coverage transfers, stronger arithmetic/geometry exclusions and attaining witnesses are not supplied by these configurations.
Disc-all queries cover every m=3..n; historical D12..D26 used a separate published bound for m<n, then enumerated only n one-pronged punctures.
The source report already contains exact root intervals; no new root computation or search was used to assemble this index.
